profile_summary: Presales and technical product specialist working the customer-facing bridge between engineering, product and sales across enterprise tech and telecom. No fleet telematics on the CV: the honest match is hardware-plus-data sold into operations teams, connected-device evaluation, and the discovery-to-viable-solution motion Geotab runs with partners and end-users. Currently covers requirements discovery, solution feasibility and pricing input on a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator account at Huawei. Delivered 100 percent of a regulator's mandates inside a 14-day window at Bank of China, and generated GBP 350,000 in B2B pipeline at Apple by running discovery through to solution positioning. MSc Business Analytics, University of Exeter.

bullets: Turned customer input into documented solution scope for a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator by covering the full requirements cycle across 3 technical workshops and a structured analysis session with the account's engineering stakeholders.

Got hardware in front of the customer's evaluation teams ahead of decision points by owning the demo unit programme for a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator, tracking 60 to 80 live evaluation devices against launch deadlines, clearing cross-border transfers and holding sign-off throughout.

Cleared the technical path for the pursuit team's proposal by validating solution feasibility across 6 account subnets before commitment, as dedicated presales cover inside a 5-person cross-functional pursuit team.

Cut USD 2 per unit in product cost for a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator by making the case across GTM roadmap and pricing reviews that a low-value feature carried no weight in the customer's buying decision.

Cut about an hour a week of sign-off document assembly and removed the daily manual check across 60 to 80 live evaluation devices by building VBA automation and a scheduled task that generates documents from template and raises deadline reminders automatically.

Delivered 100 percent of the HKMA's regulatory mandates inside a hard 14-day window by translating the regulation into an implementation plan and coordinating internal teams and third-party vendors to ship Geo-IP fraud detection with impossible-travel logic.
Kept competing projects moving by arbitrating manday conflicts across priorities, either absorbing dependent work directly or building the business case for a timeline change.
Recovered 8 hours a week of manual reporting effort, about 400 hours a year, across 20 systems by deploying a centralised Grafana observability framework in place of hand-assembled weekly reports.

Closed a 3-year-old backlog in e-banking incident triage by specifying and validating a Python anomaly-detection prototype, built with a developer, that separated critical incidents from deployment noise across 50,000+ historical logs.

Closed requirements gaps before anything reached JIRA by standardising intake with a 7-question elicitation framework covering objective, context, stakeholders, success criteria, scope, constraints and evidence sources, backed by follow-up interviews.
Won reporting-tool adoption from all 6 flagship store leaders by demoing it myself, walking each through their own use cases and daily upkeep before handing over ownership.

Reversed a headquarters decision on store training strategy by presenting evidence that store operations varied by location, moving Apple's Shanghai development team off centralised training onto store-specific delivery.

Eliminated roughly 1,500 manual hours a year across 6 flagship stores by replacing a 5-hour-per-store weekly data entry routine with a self-maintaining reporting setup, moving regional directors from lagging reports onto current labour data.
Recovered 400+ leadership hours a year by turning an 8-hour weekly interruption drain into a structured digital ticketing queue adopted store-wide.

Generated GBP 350,000 in new B2B pipeline across a 50+ account portfolio by running discovery, solution positioning and qualification end to end, then escalating matured accounts to the corporate sales team to close.

Closed a GBP 50,000 deal with Hong Kong broadcaster Viu TV over 3 months by turning a walk-in store visit into a qualified opportunity, building credibility through hands-on technical support and a custom business pricing portal, then clearing their device-management objection by upselling MDM.
Onboarded 12 portfolio accounts onto custom stores with post-sales service coverage.

skills_line: Skills: Presales discovery and requirements elicitation, technical demonstrations and workshops, solution feasibility validation, RFI/RFP support, value engineering and pricing input, cross-functional stakeholder coordination, Python (pandas, data analysis), VBA automation, Grafana, JIRA
interests_line: Interests: Connected hardware and IoT, systems design, sustainable transport

criteria: A: Customer-facing technical discovery, demos and presentations, translating technical detail for technical and non-technical audiences (repeated: 'Conduct discovery, requirements gathering, technical demonstrations, and presentations'; 'Excellent communication and presentation abilities for technical and non-technical audiences')

B: Cross-functional technical liaison bridging sales, product and customer care as key technical resource for partners and end-users (repeated: 'bridges sales channels, customer care, and product management'; 'Partner with revenue-generating and product teams as key technical resource')

C: Analyzing business challenges and identifying viable technical solutions, commercial/value-engineering judgment ('Analyze business challenges and identify viable Geotab solutions'; 'Ensure partner and end-user satisfaction')
D (gate): Professional customer-facing technical experience in software engineering, data analysis or systems integration
E (gate, gap): Working knowledge of telematics, IoT and APIs, and related technologies
